{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = data[data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {len(duplicate_patients)}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {len(missing_baseline)}")

# Check for association between arm and severity
crosstab = pd.crosstab(data['arm'], data['severity'])
print("\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity:")
print(crosstab)

# Show the distribution of sample_seq per patient
duplicates_by_patient = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f"\nMax sample_seq per patient (to confirm deduplication logic):\n{duplicates_by_patient.head()}")"}
